title: The Commonwealth of Oceana
author: James Harrington
description: "The Commonwealth of Oceana" by James Harrington is a work of political philosophy published in 1656.
longDescription: Initially censored by Oliver Cromwell, this allegorical vision reimagines England as the utopian republic of Oceana.

authorInfo.bio: James Harrington (1611–1677) wrote The Commonwealth of Oceana. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
authorInfo.edition: Complete historical source edition, with original credits and licence retained.
